    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        E = state_variables[0, :]
        I = state_variables[1, :]

        P = self.P
        Q = self.Q
        a_e = self.a_e
        a_i = self.a_i
        alpha_e = self.alpha_e
        alpha_i = self.alpha_i
        b_e = self.b_e
        b_i = self.b_i
        c_e = self.c_e
        c_ee = self.c_ee
        c_ei = self.c_ei
        c_i = self.c_i
        c_ie = self.c_ie
        c_ii = self.c_ii

        k_i = self.k_i

        r_i = self.r_i
        shift_sigmoid = self.shift_sigmoid
        tau_e = self.tau_e
        tau_i = self.tau_i
        theta_e = self.theta_e
        theta_i = self.theta_i

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)
        c_glob = coupling[0, :]

        # Derived Variables
        self.lc_0 = lc_0 = E * local_coupling
        self.lc_1 = lc_1 = I * local_coupling
        self.x_e = x_e = alpha_e * (
            P + c_glob + lc_0 + lc_1 - theta_e + E * c_ee - I * c_ei
        )
        self.x_i = x_i = alpha_i * (Q + lc_0 + lc_1 - theta_i + E * c_ie - I * c_ii)
        self.s_e = s_e = c_e / (
            1.0 + np.exp(-a_e * (x_e - b_e))
        ) - 1.0 * shift_sigmoid / (1.0 + np.exp(a_e * b_e))
        self.s_i = s_i = c_i / (
            1.0 + np.exp(-a_i * (x_i - b_i))
        ) - 1.0 * shift_sigmoid / (1.0 + np.exp(a_i * b_i))

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray((-E + s_e * (k_e - E * r_e)) / tau_e),  # E
            np.asarray((-I + s_i * (k_i - I * r_i)) / tau_i),  # I
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
